type U = {kind: "s", f: (x: string) => void} | {kind: "n", f: (x: number) => void};
const tag = "s";
const a: U = {kind: tag, f: x => console.log(x.toUpperCase())};
a.f("a");
const kind = "s";
const b: U = {kind, f: x => console.log(x.toUpperCase())};
b.f("b");
const tags = {kind: "s" as const};
const c: U = {kind: tags.kind, f: x => console.log(x.toUpperCase())};
c.f("c");
const d: U = {kind: ((tag)), f: x => console.log(x.toUpperCase())};
d.f("d");
let known: "s" | "n" = "s";
const e: U = {kind: known, f: x => console.log(x.toUpperCase())};
e.f("e");
const template: U = {kind: `${tag}`, f: x => console.log(x.toUpperCase())};
template.f("template");
type Prefixed = {kind: "tag-s", f: (x: string) => void} | {kind: "tag-n", f: (x: number) => void};
const prefixed: Prefixed = {kind: `tag-${tag}`, f: x => console.log(x.toUpperCase())};
prefixed.f("prefixed");
const parenthesized: U = {kind: (`${tag}`), f: x => console.log(x.toUpperCase())};
parenthesized.f("parenthesized");
const numeric = 1;
type NumericTag = {kind:"tag-1",f:(x:string)=>void}|{kind:"tag-2",f:(x:number)=>void};
const withNumber: NumericTag = {kind:`tag-${numeric}`,f:x=>console.log(x.toUpperCase())};
withNumber.f("numeric");
